critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/shell.py:196-223 — /clips still picks only the single MOST-RECENT active campaign (sort by created_at desc). If a fresh campaign is created without clip_image_url AND without a marketplace_profile with cover_urls/logo_url, `image` will silently be null again (iter106 regression risk). Recommend either (a) filtering the campaigns query to `clip_image_url: {$ne: null}` OR joining with marketplace_profiles and preferring a campaign whose sponsor has a cover_url. Currently it works because cmp_dr_mehta_appt has clip_image_url set — brittle.

backend/routes/shell.py:235 — `return {items: clips[:limit + 1], count: len(clips)}` — the +1 slicing off-by-one from iter106 is still there (docstring says 'limit'). Consider fetching `channels.limit(limit)` and returning `clips[:limit+1]` only when a sponsored clip was added, so count/items stay consistent.

backend/routes/shell.py:172-180 — Venue market matching does `blob in t or t in blob` — the reverse (t in blob) matches short markets like 'dfw' inside a longer blob but is asymmetric. Works for the seeded data but a market string like 'dubai marina' with market='dubai' matches (fine), while 'dallas' + city='dallas' when the profile.market='dfw' and locations[].city='Dallas' still matches via the city term. Good — but consider normalising synonyms (dfw ↔ dallas) once, up front, in a small map to keep intent explicit.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:109-122 — /ensure sets `art_gen_attempted:true` up-front then fires the background task. If the generation fails (timeout/API), `art_gen_attempted` stays true, which SHORT-CIRCUITS subsequent /ensure calls forever (line 118). Recommend resetting `art_gen_attempted=false` in `_run_generation` failure path, or gating the short-circuit on `art_gen_attempted && artwork_status != 'failed'` — otherwise a transient OpenAI outage permanently pins a station to placeholder.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:126-140 — /ensure-flagship-art has no auth. Anyone can trigger up to 12 gpt-image-1 generations per call. Not exploitable in preview (queued=0) but in prod could be abused for OpenAI cost. Recommend either rate-limiting by IP, requiring auth, or adding a `once-per-day` cooldown at the collection level.

backend/services/station_art.py:50-66 — resolve_art has a subtle bug: `station.get('art_source') == 'owner'` requires BOTH art_source AND art_url. But the second branch reads `ov = station.get('owner_overrides') or {}` and returns 'owner' from ov.artwork_url irrespective of art_source. If a station has art_source='ai' AND owner_overrides.artwork_url set, this returns owner (correct). But if art_source is somehow 'placeholder' AND art_url points to a stale value, we fall through to flagship_art/artwork_url/cover_image_url — which is the desired self-healing behaviour. Order is fine, just worth a code comment noting the precedence explicitly.

backend/services/station_art.py:47 — `_is_real_image` only excludes ui-avatars. A real logo_url could still be a broken/deadlink domain and would be considered 'real'. Fine for the current dataset, but worth adding a HEAD-check job (offline) to demote broken favicons to placeholder.

frontend/src/Home.jsx — sponsored clip claim sheet CTA (clip-claim-btn) becomes unreachable via keyboard when the sheet is open only via `Enter` on the card — trap-focus is not set. Minor a11y concern.

frontend/src/LiveRadioStation.jsx:470-490 — owner-artwork-manager renders with 3 controls but there is no loading/success toast after 'Generate AI artwork' click (image gen is real and takes 10-60s). Consider polling /artwork/status and updating the tile art on completion so the owner sees the new art without a manual refresh.
